Power saving from the Battery widget

Android only lets an app switch power saving after a one-time grant from a computer:

adb shell pm grant com.monolith.widgets android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS

Until then, tapping the widget opens the power saving screen.
Granted. Tapping the Battery widget switches power saving on and off.
Set Settings → Apps → Monolith → Battery → Unrestricted so Battery and Screen time stay current. Clocks keep time on their own.
